gotchas: 'Get Pro' CTA = https://cursor.com/api/auth/checkoutDeepControl?yearly=false (yearly=true for annual); redirects to WorkOS AuthKit on authenticator.cursor.sh, so the vault login must be registered to authenticator.cursor.sh.
Login is email-first then password; the password step carries a Cloudflare Turnstile (captcha handoff), followed by an email OTP (owner handoff, no totp).

After login you land on hosted Stripe Checkout (checkout.stripe.com), inputs same-document (no iframes). Total shows in .ProductSummary-totalAmount as '$20.00' but the proxy's total reader reported 'order total could not be established' on every attempt, including after billing address was filled, so card fill was blocked.
